assumptions: The VOA is the simple affine algebra L_k(so(2n)) at k=-h^vee+h^vee/3.
The physical R-filtration is good: R(a_(j)b) <= R(a)+R(b)-1 for j>=0, and R(J)=1.
The top diagonal is the reduced Higgs ring of the stated orbit; lower-size Pfaffian minors are nonzero there.

filtration_certificate.homogeneity_justification: At conformal degree n the determinant-character flavor singlet is uniquely the scalar Pfaffian: saturating all 2n indices requires n undifferentiated currents and the epsilon contraction. Thus it cannot mix different R components with the same symmetries. All displayed norms are nonzero, so these vectors survive the simple affine quotient.
filtration_certificate.norm_derivation: Repeated exact double-pole contractions give product_j(k+2j); invariance makes all perfect-matching contributions equal, giving the positive factor (2m-1)!!.

proof: The Pfaffians of order 4 are nonzero Higgs classes, so their R is 4.
J[1] acting on an order-5 Pfaffian gives a nonzero multiple of an order-4 Pfaffian. Goodness therefore forces R >= 4.
The order-5 Pfaffians vanish on the Higgs orbit, excluding R=5. Thus R=4.
J[1] acting on the scalar order-6 Pfaffian is nonzero, forcing R >= 4. The scalar vanishes on the Higgs branch, so R <= 5.
The exact norm has sign (-1)^4, excluding R=5. Thus the scalar Pfaffian also has R=4.

assumptions: A skew 12 by 12 matrix M has coordinates of (q,T)=(1,1).
Each basic invariant I_d has a graph variable of (q,T)=(d,d-1).
The original ideal is generated by graph equations and the gradient of a*I2^2+b*I4, b nonzero.
The target reduced orbit closure has Jordan partition [3, 3, 3, 3].
historical_obstruction.conclusion: At least 66 independent classes at (q,T)=(5,5) survive in this graph model and vanish in the reduced Higgs-orbit ring.
historical_obstruction.hl_survival_proof: Each Pfaffian has T=5. Every q=5 monomial of smaller T contains a positive jet or a graph variable and has parity support at most 8; lowering its filtration is impossible in this graph model.
historical_obstruction.independence_proof: Distinct subsets have distinct parity; none occurs in this homogeneous piece of the original ideal or its T-initial subspace.

historical_obstruction.interpretation: The stated model cannot pass the required reduced Higgs-orbit HL check at this degree for any nonzero I4 coefficient. A new physically justified filtration or model is required; changing the scalar period coefficients alone cannot fix it.
historical_obstruction.pfaffian_nonzero_witness: For each subset, its consecutive-pair perfect-matching monomial has coefficient +1.
historical_obstruction.scope: Exact obstruction for the specified graph filtration; no claim identifying a corrected physical Macdonald index.
historical_obstruction.target_vanishing_proof: Every matrix in the orbit closure has rank at most 8, so all 10-index Pfaffians vanish.

notes: The Pfaffian mismatch in the historical scalar-only trial filtration is corrected. Higher orders and jump + 2 completion remain separate checks.
The character formula applies to the KLS candidate through the first null only. Higher flavor decompositions are not inferred from unrefined dimensions.
